name: Raspberry Pi High Quality Camera (C/CS-mount)
description: 12.3 MP Sony IMX477 camera board with a milled aluminium C/CS lens mount, focus ring and 1/4-20 tripod thread for a Raspberry Pi (lens sold separately).

specs.label: Sensor
specs.value: Sony IMX477R, 12.3 MP, 4056 × 3040, 1.55 µm pixels, 7.9 mm diagonal, rolling shutter

specs.label: Lens mount
specs.value: CS-mount (C-mount via included adapter); back focus 12.5–22.4 mm (M12 variant: 2.6–11.8 mm)

specs.label: Interface
specs.value: MIPI CSI-2 via 200 mm ribbon; external trigger supported

specs.label: IR filter
specs.value: Integrated Hoya CM500 IR cut (removable, irreversible)

envelope.axes: x × y = board face, z = depth excl. lens per CS drawing (docs table says 18.4 mm excl. lens; M12 variant 17.8 mm)

features.label: PCB mounting holes
features.value: 4× Ø2.5 mm, 4 mm in from each edge of the 38 × 38 mm board (30 × 30 mm pattern)

features.label: Lens mount (CS)
features.value: Bore Ø22.4, Ø30.75 and Ø36 mm focus ring, centered on the board; sensor window 8.5 mm

features.label: Tripod
features.value: 1/4"-20 in the lens-mount tab on the bottom edge (tab 13.97 mm wide); side view offsets 7.62 / 12.04 mm, tab 5.71 × 2.75 mm

features.label: Stack-up (side view)
features.value: Focus ring 5.8 mm, 1.2 mm, 5.02 / 10.35 mm to the PCB, PCB 1.4 mm; 10.16 mm FPC connector at the top (0.8 mm offset)

features.label: M12 variant
features.value: Same 38 × 38 board and holes; M12 holder Ø34.8 mm, lens Ø15.95, 17.2 / 8.9 mm square, total 17.8 mm deep

amazon.title: Raspberry Pi HQ Camera Module, 12.3MP Sony IMX477R Sensor, RAW12/10/8 Output, Compatible Boards, C/CS-Mount

notes: Record is for the C/CS-mount variant (SC0261). M12 variant on Amazon: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BRY5LGF6 ('Raspberry Pi Camera - M12 mount', Raspberry Pi Store; page bullets mention IMX477R and the M12 back focus, verified). Both Amazon listings are from the Raspberry Pi Store. Depth conflict: CS drawing 18.58 mm vs docs table 18.4 mm (excl. lens). The file the site calls 'hq-camera-m12-mechanical-drawing.pdf' is actually the full product brief (both drawings on p.4). An official lens-mount-only drawing exists: https://pip-assets.raspberrypi.com/categories/659-raspberry-pi-high-quality-camera/documents/RP-008199-DS-1-hq-camera-cs-lensmount-drawing.pdf.
